claude.sample_unit: patients (MIMIC-IV breast cancer cohort, external test)
models_evaluated: five classifiers (unspecified) trained on Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer dataset

links.outcome: AUROC drop on external MIMIC-IV cohort versus internal Wisconsin performance
links.effect: Wisconsin AUROC above 0.98; MIMIC external AUROC dropped to 0.45-0.57 for base and globally calibrated variants, confirming distributional shift.
links.quote: Performance fell sharply on the MIMIC external cohort: AUROC dropped to 0.45-0.57 for base and globally calibrated variants, confirming distributional shift.

links.outcome: Calibration error variation across racial and gender subgroups (DCGS) masked by aggregate metrics
links.effect: DCGS exceeded the 0.05 threshold in 28 of 40 model-calibration combinations on the race axis; racial DCG exceeded 0.15 for all 20 model-variant combinations.
links.quote: DCGS exceeded the 0.05 clinical significance threshold in 28 of 40 model-calibration combinations on the race axis.

links.outcome: Whether global recalibration (Platt, isotonic) reduces demographic calibration gaps
links.effect: Neither global Platt nor isotonic calibration reliably reduced DCGS below the 0.05 threshold; population-level ECE reduction did not reliably close demographic gaps.
links.quote: Reducing population-level ECE through global recalibration does not reliably close demographic calibration gaps.

links.outcome: Effect of recalibration methods on calibration gaps in local (MIMIC) cohort
links.effect: Global Platt and isotonic calibration did not reliably reduce DCGS below 0.05; subgroup-targeted Platt scaling was also tested on MIMIC cohort.
links.quote: Neither global Platt nor isotonic calibration reliably reduced DCGS below that threshold.

links.outcome: Reporting of calibration by subgroup and conformal coverage under shift
links.effect: Conformal coverage collapsed to roughly 25% on MIMIC; aggregate statistics miss subgroup calibration error, and most studies skip calibration reporting.
links.quote: Conformal coverage collapsed to roughly 25% on MIMIC, and racial DCG exceeded 0.15 for all 20 model-variant combinations.

unlisted_practices: Using a standardized demographic calibration gap score (DCGS) with bootstrap CIs to detect subgroup calibration disparities
